source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 2 同主题完形(初到异国的双语周/外婆的方言/英语改变了我看世界的方式/班级辩论/善意之词的力量/演讲中的过渡语)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞。

passages.title: My First Week Abroad
passages.text: When I arrived in London as an exchange student, I quickly learned that having a (1)____ language was like owning a second pair of eyes. She said that the daily effort to (4)____ between two languages would actually make my brain stronger. Slowly, I began to (5)____ sounds that I had never noticed before. What surprised me most was (6)____ a single kind sentence from a stranger could lift my whole day. I started to keep a (7)____ in which I wrote down new words every evening. Reading it later, I could clearly (8)____ how much progress I had made. By the end of the week, English no longer felt like a wall but like a door that had begun to (9)____ up. The (10)____ is that learning a language slowly changes the way you see everything.

passages.title: Grandma's Words
passages.text: My grandmother speaks an old village (1)____ that very few young people still use. When I was small, I thought it sounded strange, and I could not (2)____ many of her words. passages.title: How English Changed My World
passages.text: Before I learned English well, I thought a language was just a set of words for naming things. Now I (1)____ that it is much more than that. (9)____ matters is not which language is better, but how each one opens a new window. The (10)____ is that every language I learn makes me a slightly different person.

passages.title: Should We Learn More Than English?
passages.text: Last week our class held a debate on a simple question: is English the only foreign language (1)____ learning? passages.title: The Power of Kind Words
passages.text: What was the most beautiful thing someone ever said to you? It could have been a single sentence that (1)____ your whole day, or even your year. passages.title: Guiding Your Audience
passages.text: A good speaker is a little like a guide leading people along a path. As you move from one idea to the (1)____, you must show your audience the way, or they may get lost.
